question: In a certain code language, 'PSYCHIC' is written as 'YSPCCIH' and 'CITIZEN' is written as 'TICINEZ'. How will 'MAHATMA' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

​So,

 
• 'PSYCHIC' is written as 'YSPCCIH'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36cdba1d00aaecb0611fcc66e8a99c008449cb119dc091b4fdf7b7c0a6a16d2f.png] 

And,

 
• 'CITIZEN' is written as 'TICINEZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b2805bfe2eddbe5a89b8091763d4aff0bea7e600bac36bf597c8aefb51d0f0b.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• 'MAHATMA' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bb63fd0319d3711e1affe1071ea6fa69c0b30e34e73dd382a46378556bd2034.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "HAMAAMT**".
